name: SpotLessSplats (SLS)
definition: A framework for robust 3D scene reconstruction with 3DGS that uses unsupervised detection of outliers in training images by leveraging pre-trained text-to-image features and robust optimization to ignore transient distractors.
summary: SpotLessSplats is a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that reconstructs static scenes from casual video by using semantic features to ignore transient distractors.
